pages.text: Tinkers' metal tools need a smeltery.$(br2)1. Smelt $(l:crafting/smeltery#smeltery_seared_grout)Grout$(/l) into seared bricks.$(br)2. A $(l:crafting/smeltery#smeltery_seared_grout)Seared Melter$(/l) will get you started.

3. Cast a $(l:crafting/smeltery#smeltery_controller)Smeltery Controller$(/l) from molten copper over seared bricks, then wall it in with seared bricks, a drain and a lava tank.$(br)4. Pour through a $(l:crafting/smeltery#smeltery_seared_faucet)Faucet$(/l) into a $(l:crafting/smeltery#smeltery_seared_faucet)Casting Table$(/l) or basin.$(br2)The $(l:crafting/smeltery#foundry_controller)Foundry$(/l), built from scorched bricks, does the same and gives back byproducts.

pages.title: Further Reading
pages.text: The $(l)Materials and You$() goes deeper. The smeltery has books of its own.
